muc.title: Where do I start?
muc.text: Mark wants to teach himself AI, but doesn't know where to start. Bit maps out a four-step path, about one week per step.

muc.title: Understand what AI really is
muc.text: Step one, understand what AI really is: it guesses words, sometimes makes things up, sometimes forgets. Watch the Getting started region on the map.

muc.title: Use it every day
muc.text: Step two, use it every day: write 4-part prompts, teach AI who you are, save a prompt library.

muc.title: Look inside
muc.text: Step three, look inside: tokens, attention, AI learning from mistakes. Once you understand the machine, you know when to trust it.

muc.title: Bring it into real work
muc.text: Step four, bring it into real work: pick a repeated task, hand it to AI, measure the results, and use AI to learn something new.

muc.title: Watch one, do one
muc.text: The secret is one video a day, then ten minutes on the try-it-now part. If you only watch without doing, you'll forget as soon as you close it.

muc.title: Schedule 4 weeks
muc.text: Open your calendar, block ten minutes every evening for four weeks, and write the name of the step you're on.

muc.title: Episode 100
muc.text: And the next episode is number one hundred: a look behind the scenes at how this channel is made.
